notes: YPM catalog number YPM ANT 006207 (accession YPM.01950, received via loan, 1888). YPM record title: "(229 Pl.39) Fragment of a Hieratic Papyrus. Egypt."; 'Other Attributes: Period = Greco-Roman'. No more precise date in the record. Photo by J. Domian, 2006 (IIIF canvas 2 of the manifest); cropped to the papyrus on its card backing. The text is late funerary-style hieratic with column rules; the label is the museum's.
